fixes.defect: ROM ratio-1 prefill KV join (layers 20-39) interleaved [current r, compressed r] one token per iteration; ATTENTION.SPARSE addresses every current row, then compressed row j at span + j
fixes.root_cause: CONCAT with a span_tokens*2 output is not a MULTIPLIED_SPAN_BATCH_KIND, so _shape_of gave it the per-token fallback (iteration t presents that token's multiplied rows)
fixes.fix: a phase-selected axis-0 CONCAT is one block over the whole span (whole_span_join in compiler/backends/rom/common/program.py::_shape_of), whatever the target token block

fixes.root_cause: the phase-layout join and its consumers opened their CONTEXT_LENGTH loop with bound_divisor = capability max_context_positions (1,048,576) against a compressed plane of 8,192 rows, so A18's walk test (dim >= step, 3d33a008) resolved no extent

fixes.root_cause: neither backend honoured committed_row: absolute_position on main.compressed_token_ids
fixes.fix: both write the request's rows at POSITION_START + row (HBM state-view POSITION_START term; ROM _absolute_row_view with the source as principal); HBM opens a context loop for the ring's NGRAM_HASH readers; the ring objects carry the capability POSITION_START range as an unreachable tail (HBM StatePlacement.position_pad_rows, ROM group object bytes) so the verifier proves the term in bounds
